market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. US-Iran conflict keeps oil elevated, yields at 5%+ pressure equities. Asian stocks to fall further. Gold tests support. Consumer stress peaks at Labor Day. Expect 3-5% equity drawdown risk in next 2-3 weeks. Bond market functioning 'normally' per Treasury but at stressed levels.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Venezuela energy reopening adds structural supply. AI capex cycle (Anthropic, Nvidia, UMC) supports tech earnings through 2027. Dividend growers offer stability. Apple-Ternus AI pivot is multi-year positive. Key risk: if Iran conflict resolves, oil normalizes and inflation eases, enabling rate cuts by Q1 2027.
